_comment: SWARM-GUARD-3 single budget registry (t_418565a8) + SWARM-GUARD-1 backlog gate (t_0cb42501). ONE authoritative file: iteration-unit budgets per card class, per-class item caps consumed by mint_surface_check.py, and the backlog card-row cap consumed by backlog_gate.py. Every value is an INTEGER; a non-integer here is a FAIL-CLOSED signal by design, not a parse fallback.
_owner: SWARM-GUARD-3 t_418565a8 (budget coherence). backlog_gate card_row_cap added by SWARM-GUARD-1 t_0cb42501 2026-11-15.

iteration_budget._unit: iteration counts (same unit as goal_max_turns / agent.max_turns). One worker turn = one budget unit. Wall-clock is max_runtime_seconds, modelled elsewhere.
iteration_budget._admission_path: gateway/session_kanban.py build_kanban_policy lines 80-91: NON-goal card goal_max_turns -> params.max_turns -> agent.max_turns, CLAMPED 5..120; NULL -> profile agent.max_turns (=30, the silent death default). delegation.max_iterations=20 gates delegation CHILDREN only, not kanban workers — kept here as a reported fact.
iteration_budget._band_rationale: pinto-local admission clamp 5..120 (session_kanban.py:90). A budget outside the band is silently IGNORED by admission — so the registry check makes it RED instead.
iteration_budget._slice_rationale: slice_size_iterations = median iterations per SUCCESSFUL article from the perf ledger, clamped to [floor, ceiling]; requires >= min_sample_size success samples and cap-death ratio <= dominance ratio, else FAIL CLOSED to fail_closed_iterations. Failure medians are NEVER fed back — only completed-task samples count. Measured 2026-11-15: task_events completed payloads carry NO budget_used (0/20251) and task_runs has no iteration column, so per-article success samples exist only where a success sentinel exists (TAIWANDAILY absorb ledger); every other class runs fail-closed at 8 until the dispatcher instruments per-run budget_used on completions.

backlog_gate._cap_rationale: Card rows, not articles. Pile re-derived LIVE 2026-11-15 13:41: 78 open rows (74 needs_reslice + 4 NULL-block 'Iteration budget exhausted' signature; Grok cited 64 at card-writing time). Cap 70 < pile => the gate bites NOW on all net-new content mints and holds until the SWARM-GUARD-4 reslice lane drains under 70; the rescue lane (backlog_check rescue=True) is exempt so the drain itself is never gated. Re-derive, never memorize: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/backlog_gate.py --check
backlog_gate._unit: open kanban card rows (needs_reslice OR block_kind NULL with 'Iteration budget exhausted' signature)
